title: Session-scoped conversational visual input
description: Specified, not executed. Additive negotiated sidecar contract; does not widen frozen runtime-api, provider-messages, prepared-context or memory-record schemas. Normative semantics: docs/30-conversational-vision.md.

VisualScope.description: Trusted host rederives principal and all bindings. A client or model supplied scope confers no authority. Every asynchronous publication compares this entire tuple.

NegotiationScope.description: Read-only negotiation may have no camera binding or relationship. Unknown values are null; capture operations require a concrete physical source binding and never fabricate one.

VisualBounds.description: Reference ceilings; effective configuration may tighten these bounds. Numeric values are qualification targets, not measured hardware achievements. UTF-8 byte, decoded-image and tokenizer limits require semantic validation.

ClockChallenge.description: Single-use authenticated challenge. Host retains send times and validates echo/current session; client-supplied host times are never authoritative.

ClockMapping.description: Host-calculated offset interval [send-endpointReceive, return-endpointReceive]. Conservative uncertainty is the full interval width plus elapsedSinceMappingMs * 0.0001 (100 ppm drift allowance), never half-width midpoint error. The host recomputes this bound for each frame at capture/admission and rejects values above 250 ms; elapsed time must be explicit and nonnegative. Captured endpoint monotonic time maps through the conservative interval and host UTC anchor; lower capture bounds control freshness. Mapping expires no later than its camera lease; discontinuities invalidate it.

FrameDescriptor.description: Metadata for a same-request multipart binary part named frameId. Decoder must verify dimensions, format, SHA-256 and exact length with decompression limits; no arbitrary URL or filesystem path is accepted.

VisualMediaRef.description: Opaque volatile-buffer reference scoped to one request and current capture lease; not a durable artifact or permission to dereference. Earliest/latest capture bound the clock-aligned interval.

SubjectAttribution.description: Authentication binds a participant, not a face. Visual identity requires a supported current binding or user confirmation; appearance alone never supplies authenticated identity.

VisualAudienceEvidence.description: Camera-derived people-in-view evidence only. One visible person neither authenticates the owner nor proves full-room coverage. Host privacy policy consumes this evidence; it cannot clear unknown/shared by itself.

PreparedVisualContext.description: An internal preparation sidecar atomically selected into the existing conversation section of the one PreparedContextView. Never a second prompt/context fetch or tenth section. Its digest covers exact selected conversation section bytes; selection fences current scope, lease and source invalidation together.

VisualObservationEpisode.description: Typed observation input to existing automatic-memory intake, not an attributed owner statement. Finite existing relationship/source retention is required. MemoryRecord/2.0.0 projection uses sourceRefs and a namespaced extension binding this episode/revision; worldGrounded and participantStatement are forbidden for model-only observations.

VisualMemoryBinding.description: Required lifestream.conversationalVision extension on an existing MemoryRecord; validated together with the source episode at write, recall, export and import.

VisualMemoryProjection.description: Additive source-preserving projection, not a new memory-provider port. Host checks episode ID/revision/digest, scope, retention, sourceRefs and lifecycle consistently; direct observation factuality is unverified. Separate explicit hypothesis derivatives follow existing inferred-memory transformations and are not this direct projection. A required memory confidence is an attributable transformation-policy assessment, not a substitute for unknown perception confidence.
